note: Full target inventory. FUNCTIONAL is not complete parity.

capabilities.name: Federated multi-model hard clash detection with broad and narrow phases
capabilities.reference_behavior: Executes spatial intersection analysis between element selection sets across disciplines. Prunes spatially distant pairs, performs narrow-phase geometric intersection, suppresses duplicate unordered pairs, calculates penetration, and records clash records.
capabilities.expected_input: Structural column and MEP pipe overlapping in 3D space; rotated trays whose AABBs overlap while their oriented solids do not
capabilities.expected_output: True intersection produces one clash with penetration and clash point; rotated AABB false positive is rejected; distant pairs do not enter narrow phase
capabilities.performance: X-axis sweep-and-prune broad phase reports raw-pair, candidate, and narrow-phase counts; regression reduces 21 raw pairs to one SAT check.
capabilities.differences: Narrow phase currently supports AABBs and rigid OBBs. Triangle meshes, curves, compound solids, and transformed hierarchy instances remain planned.

capabilities.name: Clearance buffer proximity violation detection
capabilities.reference_behavior: Computes Euclidean separation distance between isolated elements and flags clearance violations where distance is less than or equal to the specified buffer threshold.
capabilities.expected_input: Axis-aligned elements separated by 0.02 m and rotated trays separated by 0.30 m
capabilities.expected_output: Clearance violations report exact AABB/OBB feature distances and witness midpoint coordinates
capabilities.performance: Broad-phase clearance expansion avoids feature-distance calculations for distant pairs.
capabilities.differences: Rigid-box vertex/face and edge/edge distance is implemented. Non-convex meshes, curves, and compound clearance sweeps are deferred.

capabilities.name: BIM Collaboration Format (BCF 2.1 XML) export and complete coordination-session persistence
capabilities.reference_behavior: Exports clash viewpoints and component identifiers to industry standard BCF XML structure and roundtrips multi-model coordination state natively.
capabilities.expected_input: Coordinated multi-model session with oriented geometry, configured tests, selection sets, clash results, and review state
capabilities.expected_output: BCF XML with origin coordinates and components; native schema restores sources, elements, OBB bases, tests, sets, results, and dispositions
capabilities.differences: Embedded PNG snapshots and ZIP-based multi-file BCF archive packaging are planned for the GUI release.

capabilities.name: Persistent clash review dispositions with undo and stable reruns
capabilities.reference_behavior: Allows coordination reviewers to assign dispositions and comments to clash results without losing decisions when a test is rerun.
capabilities.expected_input: Approve a hard clash with a reviewer comment, undo and redo the edit, then rerun the clash test
capabilities.expected_output: Undo restores the prior disposition; redo restores approval; rerun preserves result identity, status, and comment
capabilities.performance: Constant-time history append; result matching is keyed by canonical element pair per rerun.
capabilities.differences: Assignee, due date, batch disposition, external issue synchronization, and persisted undo history are not implemented.
